formulas.ascii: Half-open: evaluate crossing parity at x_epsilon = x + (epsilon^2, epsilon), epsilon infinitesimal. Toggle when endpoint y sides differ and the exact orientation (ties: sign(dx), then sign(-dy)) agrees with edge direction. XOR rings within a part, OR parts; assign the smallest qualifying feature row. Uncertain candidates are not assigned; no owner is 0xffffffff.
